1. (Currently amended) An apparatus, comprising:
an encoder (300) for encoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence __selected from the group consisting of: frequency of mode usage across previously coded pictures, spatial resolution characteristics, temporal resolution characteristics, and rate-distortion optimization metrics derived from encoding statistics of one or more previously coded pictures__.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence __based on cumulative encoding statistics that differ from statistics available at the time of encoding a prior picture in the sequence__.

8. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, one or more partial encoding passes for the picture, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __wherein the determination includes a comparison operation that identifies differences between current sequence characteristics and prior sequence characteristics__.

9. (Currently amended) A method, comprising:
encoding (740, 970) mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence (740, 940, 960) __selected from the group consisting of: frequency of mode usage across previously coded pictures, spatial resolution characteristics, temporal resolution characteristics, and rate-distortion optimization metrics derived from encoding statistics of one or more previously coded pictures__.

16.
